description.source: This App uses RSA Crypto without OAEP padding. The purpose of the padding scheme is to prevent a number of attacks on RSA that only work when the encryption is performed without padding.

description.source: The App may use weak IVs like "0x00,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x00,0x00" or "0x01,0x02,0x03,0x04,0x05,0x06,0x07". Not using a random IV makes the resulting ciphertext much more predictable and susceptible to a dictionary attack.

title.text: 未找到 App Link 的 assetlinks.json 文件 [android:name={0}][android:host={1}]
title.source: App Link assetlinks.json file not found[android:name=%s][android:host=%s]

description.text: 未找到 App Link 资源验证 URL（{0}），或其配置不正确（状态码：{1}）。App Links 可将网页或邮件中的链接跳转至应用；若对应主机或域名的验证文件缺失或配置错误，恶意应用可能劫持这些链接，实施钓鱼攻击，或泄露 URI 中的个人信息、OAuth 令牌、免密登录链接及密码重置令牌等敏感数据。应在域名下部署 assetlinks.json，并在 Activity 的 intent-filter 中启用 android:autoVerify="true"。
description.source: App Link asset verification URL (%s) not found or configured incorrectly. (Status Code: %s). App Links allow users to redirect from a web URL/email to the mobile app. If this file is missing or incorrectly configured for the App Link host/domain, a malicious app can hijack such URLs. This may lead to phishing attacks, leak sensitive data in the URI, such as PII, OAuth tokens, magic link/password reset tokens and more. You must verify the App Link domain by hosting the assetlinks.json file and enabling verification via [android:autoVerify="true"] in the Activity intent-filter.

title.text: 应用允许明文网络通信 [android:usesCleartextTraffic=true]
title.source: Clear text traffic is Enabled For App[android:usesCleartextTraffic=true]

description.text: 应用允许 HTTP、FTP、DownloadManager 和 MediaPlayer 等使用明文网络通信。目标 API 级别为 27 或更低时，此配置默认值为 true；目标 API 级别为 28 或更高时默认值为 false。明文通信缺乏机密性、真实性及防篡改保护，网络攻击者可能窃听或修改传输数据而不被发现。
description.source: The app intends to use cleartext network traffic, such as cleartext HTTP, FTP stacks, DownloadManager, and MediaPlayer. The default value for apps that target API level 27 or lower is "true". Apps that target API level 28 or higher default to "false". The key reason for avoiding cleartext traffic is the lack of confidentiality, authenticity, and protections against tampering; a network attacker can eavesdrop on transmitted data and also modify it without being detected.

title.text: 应用支持直接启动模式 [android:directBootAware=true]
title.source: App is direct-boot aware [android:directBootAware=true]

description.text: 应用可以在用户解锁设备前运行。若使用自定义 Application 子类，且应用内任一组件支持直接启动，则整个自定义 Application 都被视为支持直接启动。在直接启动阶段，应用只能访问设备保护存储中的数据。
description.source: This app can run before the user unlocks the device. If you're using a custom subclass of Application, and if any component inside your application is direct - boot aware, then your entire custom application is considered to be direct - boot aware.During Direct Boot, your application can only access the data that is stored in device protected storage.

title.text: 应用配置了网络安全策略 [android:networkSecurityConfig={0}]
title.source: App has a Network Security Configuration[android:networkSecurityConfig=%s]

description.text: 网络安全配置允许应用通过安全的声明式配置文件定制网络安全设置，无需修改应用代码；可以为特定域名或应用设置相应策略。
description.source: The Network Security Configuration feature lets apps customize their network security settings in a safe, declarative configuration file without modifying app code. These settings can be configured for specific domains and for a specific app.

title.text: 应用可安装在存在未修复漏洞的 Android {0} 上 [minSdk={1}]
title.source: App can be installed on a vulnerable unpatched Android version %s, [minSdk=%s]

description.text: 应用支持安装在存在多项未修复漏洞的旧版 Android 上，这些设备无法从 Google 获得足够的安全更新。按此规则的建议，应支持 Android 10（API 29）或更高版本，以获得合理的安全更新。
description.source: This application can be installed on an older version of android that has multiple unfixed vulnerabilities. These devices won't receive reasonable security updates from Google. Support an Android version => 10, API 29 to receive reasonable security updates.

title.text: 应用可安装在存在漏洞的 Android {0} 上 [minSdk={1}]
title.source: App can be installed on a vulnerable Android version %s, minSdk=%s]

description.text: 应用支持安装在存在多项漏洞的旧版 Android 上。按此规则的建议，应支持 Android 10（API 29）或更高版本，以获得合理的安全更新。
description.source: This application can be installed on an older version of android that has multiple vulnerabilities. Support an Android version => 10, API 29 to receive reasonable security updates.

title.text: 应用开启了调试模式 [android:debuggable=true]
title.source: Debug Enabled For App [android:debuggable=true]

description.text: 应用启用了调试，使逆向分析者更容易附加调试器、获取堆栈信息并访问调试辅助类。
description.source: Debugging was enabled on the app which makes it easier for reverse engineers to hook a debugger to it. This allows dumping a stack trace and accessing debugging helper classes.

title.text: 应用允许备份数据 [android:allowBackup=true]
title.source: Application Data can be Backed up [android:allowBackup=true]

description.text: 此配置允许通过 ADB 备份应用数据。启用 USB 调试的用户可以将应用数据从设备复制出来。
description.source: This flag allows anyone to backup your application data via adb. It allows users who have enabled USB debugging to copy application data off of the device.

title.text: 应用未显式禁止数据备份，缺少 android:allowBackup 配置
title.source: Application Data can be Backed up [android:allowBackup] flag is missing.

description.text: 应将 android:allowBackup 设置为 false。该配置默认值为 true，允许通过 ADB 备份应用数据；启用 USB 调试的用户可以将应用数据从设备复制出来。
description.source: The flag [android:allowBackup] should be set to false. By default it is set to true and allows anyone to backup your application data via adb. It allows users who have enabled USB debugging to copy application data off of the device.

title.text: 应用处于测试模式 [android:testOnly=true]
title.source: Application is in Test Mode [android:testOnly=true]

description.text: 测试模式可能向应用外部暴露功能或数据，造成安全隐患。
description.source: It may expose functionality or data outside of itself that would cause a security hole.

title.text: Activity（{0}）设置了 taskAffinity
title.source: TaskAffinity is set for activity (%s)

description.text: 设置 taskAffinity 后，其他应用可能读取发往其他任务中 Activity 的 Intent。应保留默认设置，以包名作为任务亲和性，防止其他应用读取收发 Intent 中的敏感信息。
description.source: If taskAffinity is set, then other application could read the Intents sent to Activities belonging to another task. Always use the default setting keeping the affinity as the package name in order to prevent sensitive information inside sent or received Intents from being read by another application.

title.text: Activity（{0}）未使用 standard 启动模式
title.source: Launch Mode of activity (%s) is not standard.

description.text: Activity 使用 singleTask 或 singleInstance 启动模式时会成为任务根 Activity，其他应用可能读取调用它的 Intent 内容。当 Intent 包含敏感信息时，应使用 standard 启动模式。
description.source: An Activity should not be having the launch mode attribute set to "singleTask/singleInstance" as it becomes root Activity and it is possible for other applications to read the contents of the calling Intent. So it is required to use the "standard" launch mode attribute when sensitive information is included in an Intent.

title.text: Activity（{0}）存在 Android 任务劫持 / StrandHogg 风险
title.source: Activity (%s) is vulnerable to Android Task Hijacking/StrandHogg.

description.text: Activity 不应使用 singleTask 启动模式，否则其他应用可能将恶意 Activity 放到任务栈顶部，形成任务劫持 / StrandHogg 1.0 漏洞，使应用易受钓鱼攻击。可将启动模式设为 singleInstance，或设置空的 taskAffinity（taskAffinity=""）；也可将当前目标 SDK（{0}）提升至 API 28 或更高，在平台层面修复该问题。
description.source: An Activity should not be having the launch mode attribute set to "singleTask". It is then possible for other applications to place a malicious activity on top of the activity stack resulting in Task Hijacking/StrandHogg 1.0 vulnerability. This makes the application an easy target for phishing attacks. The vulnerability can be remediated by setting the launch mode attribute to "singleInstance" or by setting an empty taskAffinity (taskAffinity="") attribute. You can also update the target SDK version (%s) of the app to 28 or higher to fix this issue at platform level.

title.text: Activity（{0}）存在 StrandHogg 2.0 任务劫持风险
title.source: Activity (%s) is vulnerable to StrandHogg 2.0

description.text: 检测到 Activity 存在 StrandHogg 2.0 任务劫持风险。其他应用可能将恶意 Activity 放到受影响应用的任务栈顶部，实施钓鱼攻击。可同时设置 singleInstance 启动模式和空的 taskAffinity（taskAffinity=""）；也可将当前目标 SDK（{0}）提升至 API 29 或更高，在平台层面修复该问题。
description.source: Activity is found to be vulnerable to StrandHogg 2.0 task hijacking vulnerability. When vulnerable, it is possible for other applications to place a malicious activity on top of the activity stack of the vulnerable application. This makes the application an easy target for phishing attacks. The vulnerability can be remediated by setting the launch mode attribute to "singleInstance" and by setting an empty taskAffinity (taskAffinity=""). You can also update the target SDK version (%s) of the app to 29 or higher to fix this issue at platform level.

title.text: Content Provider 权限配置不当 [{0}]
title.source: Improper Content Provider Permissions [%s]

description.text: Content Provider 的权限配置允许设备上的其他应用访问它。内容提供者可能包含应用敏感信息，因此不应随意向外共享。
description.source: A content provider permission was set to allows access from any other app on the device. Content providers may contain sensitive information about an app and therefore should not be shared.

title.text: 发现拨号器秘密代码：{0} [android:scheme="android_secret_code"]
title.source: Dailer Code: %s Found [android:scheme="android_secret_code"]

description.text: 清单中存在秘密代码。在拨号器中输入这些代码可能访问隐藏功能，其中可能包含敏感信息。
description.source: A secret code was found in the manifest. These codes, when entered into the dialer grant access to hidden content that may contain sensitive information.

title.text: 发现监听端口 {0} 的数据短信接收器 [android:port]
title.source: Data SMS Receiver Set on Port: %s Found [android:port]

description.text: 应用配置了监听指定端口的二进制短信接收器。发往设备的二进制短信会按开发者定义的方式处理；应用应严格校验短信数据，并将收到的短信视为来自不可信来源。
description.source: A binary SMS receiver is configured to listen on a port. Binary SMS messages sent to a device are processed by the application in whichever way the developer choses. The data in this SMS should be properly validated by the application. Furthermore, the application should assume that the SMS being received is from an untrusted source.

description.text: 检测到导出的 {1} 组件，可被设备上的其他应用访问。组件受权限保护，但保护级别为 normal。恶意应用可能申请并获得该权限，进而与组件交互。若使用 signature 级别，则只有使用相同证书签名的应用才能获得权限。

However, the protection level of the  permission is set to normal. This means that a malicious application can request and obtain the permission and interact with the component. If it was set to signature, only applications signed with the same certificate could obtain the permission.

description.source: A%s %s is found to be shared with other apps on the device therefore leaving it accessible to any other application on the device. It is protected by a permission. However, the protection level of the permission is set to dangerous. This means that a malicious application can request and obtain the permission and interact with the component. description.source: The Content Provider(%s) would be exported if the application ran on a device where the API level was less than 17. In that situation, it would still be protected by a permission. However, the protection level of the permission is set to signatureOrSystem. It is recommended that signature level is used instead. Signature level should suffice for most purposes, and does not depend on where the applications are installed on the device.

description.text: Content Provider（{0}）在 API 低于 17 的设备上运行时会被导出，从而可被其他应用访问。保护该组件的应用级权限未在被分析应用中定义，应检查其定义处的保护级别。若为 normal 或 dangerous，恶意应用可能申请并获得权限，进而与组件交互；若为 signature，则只有使用相同证书签名的应用才能获得权限。
description.source: The Content Provider(%s) would be exported if the application ran on a device where the the API level was less than 17. In that situation, it would still be protected by a permission which is not defined in the analysed application. As a result, the protection level of the permission should be checked where it is defined. If it is set to normal or dangerous, a malicious application can request and obtain the permission and interact with the component. If it is set to signature, only applications signed with the same certificate can obtain the permission.
